stem_md: 设 $z=x^2f(xy,y/x)$，$f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $z_{xy}$。
search_text:
设 $z=x^2f(xy,y/x)$，$f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $z_{xy}$。 $3x^2f_1'-f_2'+x^3yf_{11}''+\frac yx f_{22}''$ $3x^2f_1'+f_2'+x^3yf_{22}''+\frac yx f_{11}''$ $3x^2f_1'+f_2'+x^3yf_{11}''-\frac yx f_{22}''$ $6x^2f_1'+f_2'+x^3yf_{11}''-\frac yx f_{22}''$ $$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x^2\left(xf_1'+\frac1x f_2'\right)=x^3f_1'+xf_2'$$

$$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=3x^2f_1'+x^3\left(f_{11}''y-\frac{y}{x^2}f_{12}''\right)+f_2'+x\left(f_{21}''y-\frac{y}{x^2}f_{22}''\right)=3x^2f_1'+f_2'+x^3yf_{11}''-\frac{y}{x}f_{22}''$$
